title: FastAsyncWorldEdit
what: A faster WorldEdit that uses less memory. It takes WorldEdit's place, so don't install both.
steps: It uses WorldEdit's commands: //wand for the wooden axe, //set, //copy, //paste and //undo.
Edits run in the background, so a big edit is less likely to freeze the server.
Plugins that need WorldEdit (such as WorldGuard) work with it too.
